old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj.10","title":"generate_eui64: random fallback produces unstable identity across reboots","description":"In lora_l2.c:generate_eui64() lines 98-101, if hwinfo_get_device_id() fails, the code falls back to sys_rand_get() for the EUI-64. This produces a different identity on every reboot, which breaks IPv6 NDP, routing state, and any peer tracking. The LOG_WRN at line 101 fires but the system continues operation. For mesh networking, an unstable EUI-64 is a silent failure - neighbors will see a 'new' node each reboot. Consider: refuse to start without stable identity, or persist a random EUI-64 to flash on first boot.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-06-27T05:47:34.393833Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-27T05:57:24.584091Z","closed_at":"2026-06-27T05:57:24.584091Z","close_reason":"Closed","labels":["maintainer-burden","owner-reserved","review","risk"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj.10","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-06-27T05:47:34.394346Z"}]}

new_value: Already fixed in current HEAD by a prior review-fix wave; verified, no further change needed. The bead's 'refuse to start without stable identity' option was implemented: generate_eui64() (lora_l2.c:264-371) no longer has any sys_rand_get() fallback (rg: sys_rand_get appears nowhere in firmware/); on hwinfo_get_device_id() failure (<0), zero-length, oversized, or all-zero hardware ID it logs LOG_ERR and returns a negative errno, and lichen_lora_l2_init() (lines 595-599) propagates the failure so the node cannot start with an unstable EUI-64. Stable identity = SHA-256('LICHEN-EUI64-v1' || hwid) first 8 bytes with U/L=1, I/G=0 bits set. NOTE for CI/next worker: while syntax-verifying this TU I found an unrelated committed compile break in this file - lichen_sha256 called with 4 args (lora_l2.c:326) vs 3-param declaration (lichen_util.h:69), a bad merge of b7c2ecb570 + 117fa9ec8c affecting bridge/module/tests; filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-sejt with full blast radius. Verification of this TU was therefore done against a temp copy with only that header decl aligned to the committed 4-param impl: clang -fsyntax-only -std=c11 -Wall --target=armv7m-none-eabi: exit 0.
